# voxcpm2-turkce-ses-tasarimi

> Turkish voice design and reading with VoxCPM2 on a 4 GB GPU: a one-command installer, a patched audio.cpp engine, a small local web UI and 14 ready-made synthetic voices. The repository contains no model weights and no recording of any person.

Rules that never change: quality is fixed (16 steps, cfg 2.0); one GPU job at a time; voice cloning only with the user's own voice or a voice with its owner's explicit permission (keep the UI permission check); patches stay LF; no personal paths, e-mail addresses or tokens in anything you write (use `<ROOT>`).

## Start here
- [tani.ps1](https://github.com/alexturkey/voxcpm2-turkce-ses-tasarimi/blob/main/scripts/tani.ps1): run this first; read-only report (system, card, Python, settings, deviations from the defaults); keep your progress in `DURUM.md` (git-ignored notebook in the repo root)
- [AGENTS_HIZLI.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/voxcpm2-turkce-ses-tasarimi/blob/main/AGENTS_HIZLI.md): 12-step decision tree and exit code to action table (English and Turkish)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/voxcpm2-turkce-ses-tasarimi/blob/main/AGENTS.md): full setup, hard rules, options, measurements and evidence labels
- [README.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/voxcpm2-turkce-ses-tasarimi/blob/main/README.md): overview, quick start (English is authoritative; 29 translations)

## When something fails
- [docs/hata_imzalari.json](https://github.com/alexturkey/voxcpm2-turkce-ses-tasarimi/blob/main/docs/hata_imzalari.json): stable error codes with the first step in English and Turkish
- [docs/SIK_HATALAR.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/voxcpm2-turkce-ses-tasarimi/blob/main/docs/SIK_HATALAR.md): common errors, one row per code

## Safety, license, privacy
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/voxcpm2-turkce-ses-tasarimi/blob/main/SECURITY.md): private reporting, what counts as a vulnerability
- [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/voxcpm2-turkce-ses-tasarimi/blob/main/PRIVACY.md): no telemetry; the only network addresses
- [ETHICS.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/voxcpm2-turkce-ses-tasarimi/blob/main/ETHICS.md): responsible use of voices
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/voxcpm2-turkce-ses-tasarimi/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute
